name: Jeremy Grantham
thesis_cn: 美股史上最大泡沫,AI 类比 1840s 铁路/互联网;下行约 −70%。
thesis_en: Largest-ever US bubble; AI echoes 1840s railways/dot-com; ~−70% downside.
method_cn: 长周期估值(CAPE、price/sales)、历史泡沫形态、GMO 7 年各资产真实回报预测。
method_en: Long-horizon valuation (CAPE, P/S), historical bubble analogs, GMO 7-yr real-return forecasts.
computable_proxy: 长期估值分位(CAPE / 市值-GDP)

check.check_cn: SPY 低于发言日收盘(泡沫开始回归)

name: John Hussman
thesis_cn: 估值指标超 1929/2000/2008;高估值遇内部结构恶化 → 突然兑现,下行 50–70%。
thesis_en: Valuation gauge exceeds 1929/2000/2008; rich value + failing internals → sudden 50–70% drop.
method_cn: 保证金调整估值 + 市场内部结构一致性(trend uniformity);两者共振才转崩盘警戒。
method_en: Margin-adjusted valuation + market-internals uniformity; both must confirm.
computable_proxy: 估值分位 + 广度/内部结构 tell(fragility 候选)

name: Jim Chanos
thesis_cn: AI 资本开支 > 互联网;期限错配、折旧游戏、循环融资;预期欺诈上升。
thesis_en: AI capex > dot-com; maturity mismatch, depreciation games, circular financing; rising fraud.
method_cn: 自下而上法务会计、现金流与 ROIC、做空具体标的。
method_en: Bottom-up forensic accounting, cash-flow & ROIC, single-name shorts.
computable_proxy: AI 簇盈利质量/折旧寿命扣分(fragility roadmap)

name: Howard Marks
thesis_cn: 「至少现在不是泡沫」「估值高但不疯」;红旗:债务放大、无产品高估值初创、循环交易。
thesis_en: "Not a bubble yet," "high but not crazy"; flags debt, product-less $50B startups, circular deals.
method_cn: 周期定位/「量市场体温」、风险与心理、备忘录式定性判断。
method_en: Cycle positioning / "taking the temperature," risk & psychology, qualitative memos.
computable_proxy: 定性红旗核对表(校准「未到泡沫」参照)

check.check_cn: SPY 未跌破发言日收盘 −20%(泡沫未破)

name: Torsten Slok
thesis_cn: 前十大 ~50× PE(超 1990s)、数据中心资本开支增速约房地产泡沫 2×,可同速回落。
thesis_en: Top-10 ~50× PE (richer than 1990s); data-center capex ~2× housing boom, can unwind as fast.
method_cn: 集中度(前十权重/PE)、资本开支占 GDP、宏观数据。
method_en: Concentration (top-10 weight/PE), capex-to-GDP, macro data.
computable_proxy: 集中度作为泡沫附加信号

check.check_cn: QQQ 跑输 RSP(集中度回落)

name: Jim Covello
thesis_cn: $1T+ AI 资本开支回报不足;引 MIT「95% 组织 AI 试点零回报」。
thesis_en: $1T+ AI capex, too little benefit; cites MIT "95% of orgs get zero AI ROI."
method_cn: AI 资本开支 ROI/回报分析。
method_en: ROI analysis on AI capex.
computable_proxy: AI 资本开支 ROI 子信号

name: David Cahn
thesis_cn: 「$600B 问题」:AI 需 ~$600B/yr 收入才撑得起投入,实产仅 ~$50–100B。
thesis_en: "$600B question": AI needs ~$600B/yr revenue vs the ~$50–100B it produces.
method_cn: 单位经济/收入缺口分析。
method_en: Unit-economics / revenue-gap analysis.
computable_proxy: AI 资本开支 ROI 子信号

name: Warren Buffett
thesis_cn: 创纪录 ~$381B 现金、连续净卖出——以行动示估值偏贵。
thesis_en: Record ~$381B cash, sustained net selling — valuation revealed by action.
method_cn: 内在价值、现金作为揭示性偏好、巴菲特指标(市值/GDP)。
method_en: Intrinsic value, cash as revealed preference, Buffett indicator (mktcap/GDP).
computable_proxy: 市值/GDP(已在 dalio_bubble 表1)+ 现金/内部人行为

check.check_cn: SPY 低于发言日收盘(等到价值)

name: Michael Burry
thesis_cn: 2019 即提被动/流动性错配「剧场拥挤、出口未变」;2025 折旧会计 + 做空 NVDA/PLTR。
thesis_en: Coined passive/illiquidity thesis in 2019; 2025 adds depreciation accounting; shorts NVDA/PLTR.
method_cn: 成分股日成交额分布(薄名字计数)、被动流向、拥挤度、内部人抛售、会计质量、13F puts。
method_en: Constituent daily-$-volume distribution, passive flows, crowding, insider selling, accounting, 13F puts.
computable_proxy: 流动性错配硬 tell(fragility v1.1 首要)

name: Mark Spitznagel
thesis_cn: 先狂欢冲顶(SPX 或破 8000)后约 −80% 崩;2022–23 加息滞后引爆。
thesis_en: Blow-off top (SPX maybe >8000) then ~−80% crash; lagged 2022–23 tightening detonates it.
method_cn: 尾部对冲/凸性(深虚值看跌)、Austrian/债务周期诊断病因;不主张空仓持币。
method_en: Tail hedging/convexity (deep-OTM puts), Austrian/debt-cycle cause; not cash-and-wait.
computable_proxy: 「先融涨后崩」支撑 melt-up 判读;凸性对冲优于清仓

check.check_cn: 先创新高、后 12m 内回撤 >30%

name: Nassim Taleb
thesis_cn: 「数十年最脆弱市场」;债务 + 高价 + AI 少数名字过度集中 → 非线性崩盘风险。
thesis_en: "Most fragile market in decades"; debt + high prices + AI concentration → non-linear crash risk.
method_cn: 脆弱性/反脆弱、凸性、杠铃(安全资产 + 凸性尾部)、极值理论。
method_en: Fragility/antifragility, convexity, barbell, extreme-value theory.
computable_proxy: 脆弱性=状态非预测(fragility_gate 哲学根基)

name: David Einhorn
thesis_cn: 被动/动量主导「打破价格发现」,资金机械流向高估值,价值投资受损。
thesis_en: Passive/momentum dominance "broke" price discovery; capital chases overvalued names.
method_cn: 深度价值 + 事件驱动多头、指数/宏观对冲、黄金;「市场已坏」结构论。
method_en: Deep-value + event-driven longs, index/macro hedges, gold; "broken markets" thesis.
computable_proxy: 被动 AUM/底层流动性错配 tell(fragility)

check.check_cn: RSP 跑赢 SPY(价格发现回归)

name: Ray Dalio
thesis_cn: 债务周期末期;美联储停 QT = 向泡沫放水,可推高金/币后再崩;危机来自政府。建议 10–15% 黄金。
thesis_en: Late debt cycle; Fed halting QT = stimulating a bubble; crisis from governments. 10–15% gold.
method_cn: 泡沫指标 6 表(1900 以来分位)+ 大债务周期 + 大周期;泡沫在货币收紧前不破,2026 加发行针。
method_en: 6-gauge bubble indicator (percentiles since 1900) + big debt cycle; pop needs tightening; 2026 adds issuance pin.
computable_proxy: = dalio_bubble 蓝本(已落地 6 表 + 双针 + 领先对)

name: Jamie Dimon
thesis_cn: 政府债务(美债/GDP 奔 120%)风险「某种债市危机」;信用下行「比想象更糟」。
thesis_en: Govt debt (US debt/GDP toward 120%) risks a "bond crisis"; credit downturn "worse than expected."
method_cn: 银行/信用视角、堡垒资产负债表、宏观/地缘风险清单;不择时。
method_en: Bank/credit lens, fortress balance sheet, macro/geopolitical checklist; no timing.
computable_proxy: 私人信贷压力、信用利差(macro_gate 信用因子/dalio 货币针)

check.check_cn: HYG 跑输 IEF(信用走坏)

name: Stanley Druckenmiller
thesis_cn: 财政挥霍 + 赤字终清算;到期墙抽离流动性;1970s 式通胀限制降息。
thesis_en: Fiscal profligacy + deficit reckoning; maturity wall drains liquidity; 1970s inflation caps cuts.
method_cn: 自上而下宏观、流动性、集中押注、动量/技术;非永久空头。
method_en: Top-down macro, liquidity, concentrated bets, momentum; not a permabear.
computable_proxy: 流动性/期限溢价、实际利率(dalio 货币针)

check.check_cn: TLT 下跌(利率/流动性收紧)

name: Albert Edwards
thesis_cn: AI 泡沫 + 财政主导 + 潜在两位数通胀;本轮缺席通常的泡沫杀手(美联储在降息)。
thesis_en: AI bubble + fiscal dominance + potential double-digit inflation; the usual killer (tightening) is absent.
method_cn: 债券 vs 股票相对价值轮动、通胀机制、长周期叙事。
method_en: Bond-vs-equity rotation, inflation-regime analysis, secular narrative.
computable_proxy: 「泡沫杀手缺席=先融涨」反面印证双针

name: Paul Tudor Jones
thesis_cn: 「主权债务泡沫」,市值/GDP 252%,均值回归约 −35%;近端仍买股、持金/币对冲。
thesis_en: "Sovereign-debt bubble," mktcap/GDP 252%, ~−35% reversion; buys stocks near-term, hedges w/ gold/BTC.
method_cn: 市值/GDP(巴菲特指标)、主权债务/财政框架、技术/动量。
method_en: Mktcap/GDP (Buffett indicator), sovereign-debt framing, technicals/momentum.
computable_proxy: 市值/GDP(dalio 表1)+ 「近端买、远端对冲」= melt-up 剧本

name: Tom Lee
thesis_cn: SPX 2026→7700,牛市第四年,「担忧之墙」助涨(或早段 10–15% 回调)。
thesis_en: SPX 7700 in 2026, bull year four, wall of worry (possible early 10–15% dip).
method_cn: 盈利/流动性/散户行为、历史类比。
method_en: Earnings/liquidity/retail behavior, historical analogs.
computable_proxy: 作为看多权重制衡 A/B/C 空头

name: Dan Ives
thesis_cn: AI「第九局的第三局」,+15% 上行,软件回调是「黄金买点」。
thesis_en: AI "3rd inning of 9," +15% upside; software selloffs are "golden buying opportunities."
method_cn: 采用/订单驱动的产业多头。
method_en: Adoption/order-driven sector bull.
computable_proxy: 提醒别只听空头(AI·科技看多)

name: Mike Wilson
thesis_cn: 仓位已出清=新牛市,杠铃买入(周期 + 大盘成长)。
thesis_en: Positioning washed out = new bull; barbell buy (cyclicals + large-cap growth).
method_cn: 仓位/情绪、盈利修正、滚动衰退框架。
method_en: Positioning/sentiment, earnings revisions, rolling-recession.
computable_proxy: 同一仓位框架、反向结论 → 「拥挤」编码为双向信号(顶或底)

name: Michael Hartnett
thesis_cn: 对 AI/科技的过度乐观与拥挤示警;主题「泡沫会更泡沫、然后破」,建议逢高减、配黄金/国际分散。
thesis_en: Warns on AI/tech euphoria and crowding; theme "bubble gets bigger, then bursts"; trim into strength, hold gold/international.
method_cn: 自研「Bull & Bear Indicator」(0–10 综合:资金流/仓位/信用/广度/股债比)+ EPFR 资金流 + 情绪/仓位。
method_en: Proprietary Bull & Bear Indicator (0–10: flows/positioning/credit/breadth/bond-equity) + EPFR flows + sentiment/positioning.
computable_proxy: 情绪/仓位/资金流广度(fragility 候选:广度、拥挤)

check.check_cn: SPY 12m 内出现 >10% 回调(拥挤解除)
